TARGET_HINT_MELEE: Click an enemy in base contact.
TARGET_HINT_POSITION: Click a point on the battlefield.
ABIOTIC_LIFE_DESC: Add [-1 Injury Dice] to rolls for this model when hit by an attack with the Gas Keyword.
ABSOLUTE_FAITH_DESC: Opponent cannot spend Blood Markers to penalize Ranged Attacks made by this model.
ACTION_AIM_TOOLTIP_DESC: Take an Aim Action and roll a Risky Success Roll; on a success, this model's Ranged Attacks get +2 Dice for the rest of its activation.
ACTION_AIM_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No bonus if the roll fails.
ACTION_ALCHEMICAL_BREW_TOOLTIP_DESC: Provides an alchemical brew giving +1 combat dice (melee/ranged) to a friendly unit.
ACTION_ALCHEMICAL_BREW_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No effect if the roll fails.
ACTION_ALCHEMICAL_BREW_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Target is buffed on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_AMMUNITION_SACRAMENT_TOOLTIP_DESC: Bless a friendly model within 1": +1 Dice to its Ranged Attacks until the end of its next Activation.
ACTION_AMMUNITION_SACRAMENT_TOOLTIP_FAIL: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_AMMUNITION_SACRAMENT_TOOLTIP_SUCC: On a 7+, the target gains +1 Dice to Ranged Attacks until the end of its next Activation.
ACTION_ARISE_AND_BE_HEALED_TOOLTIP_DESC: Roll a Risky Success Roll; on a success, the Lector or a friendly model within 3" stands back up and has its Blood/Infection Markers removed.
ACTION_ARISE_AND_BE_HEALED_TOOLTIP_FAILU: Nothing happens if the roll fails.
ACTION_ARISE_AND_BE_HEALED_TOOLTIP_SUCCE: On a 7+, the target stands up and its markers are cleared.
ACTION_BURNING_INFERNO_TOOLTIP_DESC: Hurl hellfire at an enemy within 36" (Injury Roll with the Fire keyword).
ACTION_BURNING_INFERNO_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: If you cannot or choose not to pay the Blood Marker cost, the spell is not cast — no roll, no effect.
ACTION_BURNING_INFERNO_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: If you pay the Blood Marker cost (1-3), a fireball is launched — its Blast radius equals the Blood Markers paid; a hit (or a scatter that lands on a model) also gets Ignore Armour.
ACTION_CLAIM_RELIQUARY_TOOLTIP_DESC: A model within 1" of a Reliquary can attempt to claim it with a Success Roll.
ACTION_CLAIM_RELIQUARY_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens — the Reliquary remains unclaimed this Turn.
ACTION_CLAIM_RELIQUARY_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the Reliquary is claimed for your side this Turn.
ACTION_DEFUSE_MINE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Attempt to defuse an adjacent mine (Risky). On success the mine is removed.
ACTION_DEFUSE_MINE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_DEFUSE_MINE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the mine is defused and removed.
ACTION_DEVOUR_THE_GUILTY_TOOLTIP_DESC: Swallow a nearby model (friend or foe). Risky against enemies.
ACTION_DEVOUR_THE_GUILTY_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Against an enemy this is Risky — a Failure ends this model's Activation immediately. A failed roll against a friendly model simply does nothing.
ACTION_DEVOUR_THE_GUILTY_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: The target is swallowed (hidden, counts as Down for Morale); it gains 1 Blood Marker each time this model Activates and reaches Out of Action at 6.
ACTION_DIVINE_JUDGEMENT_TOOLTIP_DESC: Place a Blood Marker on an enemy within 24" (2 if it is Demonic/Black Grail/Heretic). No line of sight required.
ACTION_DIVINE_JUDGEMENT_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_DIVINE_JUDGEMENT_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, place 1 Blood Marker on the target (2 if it is Demonic/Black Grail/Heretic).
ACTION_ELEMENTAL_CHANGE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Change the elemental nature of the caster's next attack (Risky).
ACTION_ELEMENTAL_CHANGE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_ELEMENTAL_CHANGE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the caster's next attack's elemental type changes (Fire → Gas → Shrapnel → Fire).
ACTION_ENFORCED_ORTHODOXY_TOOLTIP_DESC: Risky. On success, all friendly Down models within 8" immediately stand up at no movement cost.
ACTION_ENFORCED_ORTHODOXY_TOOLTIP_FAILUR: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_ENFORCED_ORTHODOXY_TOOLTIP_SUCCES: On a 7+, all friendly Down models within 8" stand up at no movement cost.
ACTION_FIGHT_DEVOURER_TOOLTIP_DESC: A model devoured by a Sin Eater can only fight back with a bare-handed Melee Attack against its devourer (-3 Dice).
ACTION_FIGHT_DEVOURER_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, the attack misses; the devoured model remains trapped.
ACTION_FIGHT_DEVOURER_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the Sin Eater takes an Injury Roll.
ACTION_FORTIFY_TOOLTIP_DESC: Risky. Gain the Cover keyword until you move from this position.
ACTION_FORTIFY_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_FORTIFY_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, gain the Cover keyword until you move from this position.
ACTION_GOD_IS_WITH_US_TOOLTIP_DESC: Preaches to bolster willpower (WIL) tests of all friendly units (Risky).
ACTION_GOD_IS_WITH_US_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Priest activation ends immediately if the roll fails.
ACTION_GOD_IS_WITH_US_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: All allies are blessed on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_GOETIC_GAZE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Curse an enemy within 24" with a goetic gaze.
ACTION_GOETIC_GAZE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens — the Activation continues normally.
ACTION_GOETIC_GAZE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, place 1 Blood Marker on the target (2 if it is Demonic/Black Grail/Heretic).
ACTION_GOETIC_PORTAL_TOOLTIP_DESC: Open a portal and redeploy within 6" (Risky).
ACTION_GOETIC_PORTAL_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_GOETIC_PORTAL_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the model teleports to the chosen point within 6".
ACTION_HASTE_RISKY_TOOLTIP_DESC: Rolls a die to gain extra movement (Risky action).
ACTION_HASTE_RISKY_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Knocked Down and activation ends immediately on a roll of 1.
ACTION_HASTE_RISKY_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Gain extra movement on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_HIDE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Risky. The model hides, becoming harder to target.
ACTION_HIDE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_HIDE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the model becomes Hidden (cannot be targeted by Ranged Attacks or Charges until it moves, attacks, or an enemy gets within 1.5").
ACTION_HOLD_YOUR_FIRE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Orders a friendly unit to hold fire, increasing its defense.
ACTION_LAYING_ON_HANDS_TOOLTIP_DESC: Heals wounds/damage of a friendly unit by touch.
ACTION_LAYING_ON_HANDS_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No healing if the roll fails.
ACTION_LAYING_ON_HANDS_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Heals 3 HP on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_LOUDSPEAKERS_TOOLTIP_DESC: Broadcasts holy verses to shatter enemy faith (Risky).
ACTION_LOUDSPEAKERS_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No effect if the roll fails.
ACTION_LOUDSPEAKERS_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Enemy is shaken on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_MARCH_TOOLTIP_DESC: Moves the unit in a straight line up to its movement range.
ACTION_ONSLAUGHT_CHARGE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Charges towards an enemy. Adds +1 to melee attack dice (MEL).
ACTION_ONSLAUGHT_CHARGE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Activation ends immediately if target cannot be reached.
ACTION_ONSLAUGHT_CHARGE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Automatic Success (if enemy is in range)
ACTION_PUPPET_MASTER_TOOLTIP_DESC: Controls the mind of an enemy unit to force movement (Risky).
ACTION_PUPPET_MASTER_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No effect if the roll fails.
ACTION_PUPPET_MASTER_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Enemy is controlled for one turn on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_PURGE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Release the devoured model (Success Roll +4 Dice).
ACTION_PURGE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens — the Activation continues normally.
ACTION_PURGE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+ (with +4 Dice), the devoured model is released.
ACTION_RAVENOUS_INFECTION_TOOLTIP_DESC: Risky Action: on a Success, place 1 Infection Marker on an enemy model within 1".
ACTION_RAVENOUS_INFECTION_TOOLTIP_FAILUR: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_RAVENOUS_INFECTION_TOOLTIP_SUCCES: On a 7+, place 1 Infection Marker on the target within 1".
ACTION_SET_MINE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Set a mine on an adjacent terrain piece (+2 Dice). The piece gains the Mined keyword.
ACTION_SET_MINE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 5, nothing happens — the Activation continues normally.
ACTION_SET_MINE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 5+ (with +2 Dice), the adjacent terrain piece gains the Mined keyword.
ACTION_SHADOW_STEP_TOOLTIP_DESC: Steps through shadows, teleporting behind enemy lines.
ACTION_SHADOW_WALKER_TOOLTIP_DESC: Goetic spell: enemies cannot make Melee Attacks on the caster when it retreats.
ACTION_SHADOW_WALKER_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: If you cannot or choose not to pay the cost, the spell is not cast — the Retreat proceeds normally, enemies get their free Melee Attack.
ACTION_SHADOW_WALKER_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: If you pay the 2 Blood Marker cost, enemies within 1" cannot make a Melee Attack when this model Retreats this Activation.
ACTION_SLAVEMASTER_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: If you cannot or choose not to pay the cost, the spell is not cast — no Command is given.
ACTION_SLAVEMASTER_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: If you pay the 1 Blood Marker cost, the chosen Yoke Fiend immediately carries out the selected Command (Move/Shoot/Fight/Sacrifice).
ACTION_TAKE_AIM_TOOLTIP_DESC: Aims to add +1 to next ranged attack dice (RNG).
ACTION_TEMPORAL_ASSASSIN_TOOLTIP_DESC: On a Charge, pick a second target and teleport between both, resolving two separate melee attacks.
ACTION_TEMPORAL_ASSASSIN_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: If no second target is chosen, only the single attack resolves.
ACTION_TEMPORAL_ASSASSIN_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Automatic once the Charge succeeds (second target optional).
ACTION_TRAMPLE_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: This action itself cannot fail to be attempted — but the resulting attack can still miss on its own Success Roll like any Melee Attack.
ACTION_TRAMPLE_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Triggers automatically (no roll to use it) — resolves as a normal Melee Attack with Ignore Armour and no weapon needed, against the Down enemy.
ACTION_TREAT_TOOLTIP_DESC: Treats a wounded unit, restoring its life force.
ACTION_TREAT_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: No healing if the roll fails.
ACTION_TREAT_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: Heals 4 HP on a roll of 7+.
ACTION_TRIGGER_MARTYRDOM_DEVICE_TOOLTIP_: Detonate: every model within 3" makes an Injury Roll (the trigger rolls 4D6; within 1" +1 Injury Dice). One use.
This action cannot fail — it always detonates when used (but only once, Consumable).
Detonates immediately (no roll) — every model within 3" takes an Injury Roll; this model's own roll uses 4D6, others within 1" get +1 Injury Dice.
ACTION_VENGEFUL_SCRIPTURE_TOOLTIP_DESC: Attack an enemy within 18" (+2 Dice if within 9"). On success, Injury Roll with +1 Injury Modifier per Blood Marker the target has.
ACTION_VENGEFUL_SCRIPTURE_TOOLTIP_FAILUR: Below the required roll, nothing happens to the target.
ACTION_VENGEFUL_SCRIPTURE_TOOLTIP_SUCCES: On a Success, make an Injury Roll against the target with +1 Injury Modifier per Blood Marker it has; a Critical Success also adds Ignore Armour and +1 Injury Dice.
ACTION_VOICE_OF_GOD_TOOLTIP_DESC: Risky. Pick any not-yet-activated model (friend or foe); the Observer's activation ends and that model activates next.
ACTION_VOICE_OF_GOD_TOOLTIP_FAILURE: Below 7, nothing happens and the Activation ends immediately (Risky).
ACTION_VOICE_OF_GOD_TOOLTIP_SUCCESS: On a 7+, the Observer's Activation ends and the chosen model activates next.
AGILE_DESC: Add [+1 Dice] to Risky Success Roll when climbing, jumping, diving charging, or taking a Dash.
AIM_DESC: Perform an Aim Action, take a Risky Success Roll (+2 Dice). Success adds [+2 Dice] to the model's Ranged Attacks for the rest of its activation.
ALCHEMICAL_BREW_DESC: Provides an alchemical brew giving +1 combat dice (melee and ranged) to a friendly model for the rest of this turn.
AMALGAM_DESC: Amalgam: A huge, shambling mass of dozens of bodies of infected enemy warriors, insects, mammals, and other creatures. These aberrations march like walking mountains of diseased flesh, wielding the weapons of their victims.
ANNIHILATOR_DESC: Can take 1 Fight Action per Activation with each Melee Weapon equipped. The Off-hand Weapon modifier does not apply.
ANOINTED_HEAVY_INFANTRY_DESC: Anointed Heavy Infantry: Elite heretics wearing blackened Gehenna armor, possessing unholy strength.
ARISE_AND_BE_HEALED_DESC: Risky Success Roll: on a Success, the Lector or a friendly model within 3" stands back up and has Blood/Infection Markers removed.
ARMOURY_NO_ITEMS: No items available in this category.
ARMOURY_SELECT_UNIT: Select a model on the left to equip it.
ARMOURY_SUBTITLE: Equip your models before battle: pick a model on the left, then gear on the right.
ARMOURY_WAITING: Waiting for the opponent to finish shopping...
ARM_ALCHEMICAL_AMMUNITION_DESC: [Ammunition +1 Dice]. Can only be used with an Alaybozan, Halberd-Gun, Jezzail or Siege Jezzail.
ARM_ALCHEMIST_ARMOUR_DESC: A sealed suit of the Jabirean alchemists. Grants [-2 Injury Modifier] and negates Fire and Gas entirely.
ARM_BINOCULARS_DESC: Survey the Land: Enemy models cannot use [Infiltrator] to deploy within 16" of this model, unless in their own deployment zone.
ARM_BLACK_GRAIL_SHIELD_DESC: A rotting shield sheathed in diseased flesh. Grants [-1 Injury Modifier].
ARM_BLESSED_ICON_DESC: Talisman: Once per game, a failed [Risky Success] Roll does not end the model's Activation.
ARM_CLOAK_OF_ALAMUT_DESC: Blend In: While this model is in Cover, the enemy Ranged Attack modifier is [-2 Dice] instead of -1.
ARM_COMBAT_HELMET_DESC: A steel helmet — negates the [Shrapnel] Keyword entirely.
ARM_COMPOUND_EYES_HELMET_DESC: A helm fitted with fly-eye lenses. Negates [Shrapnel] and adds +1 Dice to Ranged Attacks.
ARM_CROWN_OF_HELLFIRE_DESC: Searing Flames: At the end of its Activation, place 1 [Blood Marker] on each enemy within 1" (except those with [Negate Fire]).
ARM_FAIL_ALREADY_OWNED: This model already has this item.
ARM_FAIL_ARMOUR: The model already wears equal or better armour.
ARM_FAIL_HANDS: The model's hands are full (max one 2H or two 1H).
ARM_FAIL_HEAVY: A model cannot carry more than one [Heavy] piece of Battlekit.
ARM_FAIL_UNIT_RULE: This model's entry does not allow this Battlekit.
ARM_FAIL_GRENADE: A model can carry only one type of Grenade.
ARM_FAIL_HEADGEAR: This model already has a piece of Headgear (only one allowed).
ARM_FAIL_KEYWORD: The model lacks the required Keyword.
ARM_FAIL_NOT_IN_TABLE: This item is not in your faction's Armoury table.
ARM_FAIL_REQUIRES_ITEM: A prerequisite item must be bought first.
ARM_FAIL_UNIT_ONLY: This item is restricted to specific models.
ARM_FIELD_SHRINE_DESC: Site of Worship: An Impassable terrain piece deployed with the model; it aids friendly models in the Morale Phase.
ARM_GAS_MASK_DESC: A filtered mask — negates the [Gas] Keyword entirely.
ARM_GRAIL_DEVOTEE_DESC: Grovelling Followers: Adds [+1 Injury Modifier] to the model's Melee Injury Rolls per Devotee (max 2 per model).
ARM_HEAVY_BALLISTIC_SHIELD_DESC: A vast steel plate only Machine Armour can carry. Grants the bearer permanent [Cover].
ARM_HELLBOUND_SOUL_CONTRACT_DESC: Fiery Exodus: When taken Out of Action, add 1 [Blood Marker] to each enemy within 1" before removal.
ARM_HOLY_ICON_SHIELD_DESC: A shield made from an icon that has worked miracles. Grants [-1 Injury Modifier] and [Impervious].
ARM_HOLY_RELIC_DESC: The bone or blood of a saint. Grants the bearer [Blessed 1].
ARM_INCENDIARY_AMMUNITION_DESC: [Consumable] [Ammunition Fire] — grants the firearm the [Fire] Keyword once per game.
ARM_INFERNAL_BRAND_DESC: An infernal sigil seared into the flesh — the bearer is immune to [Fire].
ARM_IRON_CAPIROTE_DESC: The pointed iron hood of penitent pilgrims. Negates both [Shrapnel] and [Fear].
ARM_MACHINE_ARMOUR_DESC: A steam-driven exoskeleton harness. Grants [-3 Injury Modifier] — the heaviest protection on the battlefield.
ARM_MARID_SHOVEL_DESC: A giant shovel only a Brazen Bull can lift. Follows the Shovel rules and carries the [Heavy] Keyword.
ARM_MARTYRDOM_DEVICE_DESC: An explosive charge strapped to the model. It detonates when the model is taken Out of Action or triggered.
ARM_MARTYRDOM_PILLS_DESC: Inured to Pain: If swallowed at deployment, negates [Fear] for the game and adds [-1 Injury Dice] to attacks that hit the model.
ARM_MEDI_KIT_DESC: Treat [Action]: Take a Risky Success Roll; on a success remove 1 [Blood Marker] from this or a friendly model within 1", or stand it up.
ARM_MOUNTAINEER_KIT_DESC: Ropes and Pitons: Adds +1 Dice to [Risky Success] Rolls to climb a sheer surface.
ARM_MUSICAL_INSTRUMENT_DESC: Fanfare: Adds +1 Dice to [Risky Success] Rolls for friendly models taking a Dash [Action] within 4".
ARM_REINFORCED_ARMOUR_DESC: Thickened plate for heavy infantry. Grants [-2 Injury Modifier]; only the strongest can bear its weight.
ARM_RESTRAINING_MUZZLE_DESC: Brought to Heel: Adds +1 Dice to a Yoke Fiend's Ranged Attacks and cancels its Hateful ability.
ARM_SHOVEL_DESC: Dug In: A model starting on Open terrain gains [Cover] until it moves. Can also be used as a 2-Handed Melee weapon.
ARM_STANDARD_ARMOUR_DESC: Standard issue plate for front-line troops. Grants [-1 Injury Modifier] against attacks that hit the wearer.
ARM_TAKWIN_ANQA_BIRD_DESC: Cause Confusion: Melee Success Rolls targeting this model become [Risky Success] Rolls, and enemies within 1" struggle to retreat.
ARM_TRENCH_SHIELD_DESC: A heavy shield beaten from scrap steel. Grants [-1 Injury Modifier] and occupies one hand.
ARM_TROOP_FLAG_DESC: Grants the bearer the [Leader] Keyword; the flag is Held in hand.
ARM_UNHOLY_RELIC_DESC: A damned remnant. Grants the bearer the [Fear] Keyword.
ARM_UNHOLY_TRINKET_DESC: Talisman: Once per game, a failed [Risky Success] Roll does not end the model's Activation.
ARM_WIND_AMULET_DESC: Gusts of Wind: Once per game, adds 3" to the model's Movement for that Activation.
ARTIFICIAL_LIFE_DESC: Add [-1 Injury Dice] to Injury Rolls targeting this model.
ARTILLERY_WITCH_DESC: Artillery Witch: Abhorrent spellcasters firing explosive infernal bombs at enemy trenches.
ASSAULT_BEAST_DESC: Armed with Chainsaw Mouth and Shredding Claws. Can Melee Attack using either once, or twice (using off-hand rules). Both are Risky.
ASSAULT_DRILL_DESC: Ignore the Heavy keyword for 1 Melee Weapon this model carries.
ATTACK_ALAYBOZAN_DESC: Sultanate sapper shotgun. Scatters shrapnel; usable with a shield.
ATTACK_ANOINTED_GREATSWORD_DESC: Anointed Heavy Infantry's massive two-handed greatsword. Cleave (2), +1 Injury Dice.
ATTACK_ANTI_MATERIEL_RIFLE_DESC: Anti-materiel rifle. +1 Injury Dice, Critical (+2 Injury Dice), Ignore Armour, Heavy.
ATTACK_ANTI_TANK_HAMMER_DESC: Dangerous: a successful swing places a Blood Marker on the wielder.
ATTACK_ARQUEBUS_DESC: Batter: can also be swung as a 2-handed melee weapon.
ATTACK_ASSASSINS_DAGGER_DESC: Alchemically poisoned assassin's dagger. Assault, Critical, +1 Injury Modifier. Slashing Attack: if it draws Blood, the Assassin can Dash to Retreat in the same Activation, immune to a free Melee Attack while doing so.
ATTACK_AUTOMATIC_PISTOL_DESC: Fires two shots and can be used on the charge.
ATTACK_AUTOMATIC_PISTOL_MELEE_DESC: Emptied into an enemy at arm's length.
ATTACK_AUTOMATIC_RIFLE_DESC: Fires two bursts, but both must strike the same target.
ATTACK_AUTOMATIC_SHOTGUN_DESC: 12" · 2 Hands · +1 Dice, Assault, Shotgun, Bayonet Lug, Shield Combo. Devastating up close and can be fired on the move.
ATTACK_BAYONET_DESC: Fixed to a rifle's lug. Cumbersome, but usable with a shield.
ATTACK_BEELZEBUBS_AXE_DESC: The Lord of the Flies' own blade. Every cut swarms with corruption.
ATTACK_BLASPHEMOUS_STAFF_DESC: Evil Power: +1 Dice to rolls other than attacks and Dash.
ATTACK_BLUNDERBUSS_DESC: A flared muzzle that vomits scrap metal at close range.
ATTACK_BOLT_ACTION_RIFLE_DESC: A standard-issue long rifle with a Bayonet Lug for close-quarters fighting.
ATTACK_BOW_OF_LETHE_DESC: Hunter's self-grown ranged bow. Has the Assault keyword. Before making an Injury Roll, choose either +2 Injury Dice or Ignore Armour.
ATTACK_CATHERINE_WHEEL_DESC: Spiked breaking wheel. +1 Dice, Deadly, Heavy, Risky.
ATTACK_CHAINSAW_MOUTH_DESC: War Wolf's chainsaw maw. Ignore Armour, +1 Dice, +1 Injury Dice, Risky.
ATTACK_COMMUNICANT_GREATSWORD_DESC: Communicant's holy greatsword. Cleave (1), +1 Injury Dice.
ATTACK_CORRUPTION_BELCHER_DESC: Belches a cloud of corrupting gas that ignores armour.
ATTACK_COURT_HUNTER_BLADE_DESC: Hunter's melee hunting blade with the Assault trait.
ATTACK_COURT_PRAETOR_SWORD_DESC: Praetor's heavy sword with Assault and Deadly traits.
ATTACK_DEVOURED_BARE_HANDS_DESC: A devoured model's only recourse: a bare-handed Melee Attack against the Sin Eater that swallowed it, at -3 Dice, using no weapon or ability special rules.
ATTACK_FLAIL_SCOURGE_DESC: Unwieldy: the +1 Dice does not apply when used off-hand.
ATTACK_FLAMETHROWER_DESC: A gout of burning fuel that no armour turns aside.
ATTACK_FLAME_CANNON_DESC: Greek Fire: no Success Roll — draws a 12" line and burns everything it touches.
ATTACK_FRAG_GRENADE_DESC: Fragmentation grenades — Ignore Cover, Ignore Long Range, Assault, Blast 2", Shrapnel.
ATTACK_GAS_GRENADES_DESC: 8" · -1 Injury Dice, Ignore Cover, Ignore Long Range, Assault, Blast 3", Ignore Armour, Gas. A choking cloud no armour can keep out.
ATTACK_GAVEL_OF_JUSTICE_DESC: Witchburner's gavel. Critical (+2 Injury Dice). Found Guilty: adds Blood Markers to the target after the Injury Roll.
ATTACK_GREATSWORD_AXE_DESC: A heavy two-handed blade or axe — +1 Injury Dice, Critical, Heavy.
ATTACK_GREAT_HAMMER_MAUL_DESC: A crushing two-handed weapon that caves in armour.
ATTACK_GRENADE_LAUNCHER_DESC: 36" · 2 Hands · Ignore Cover, Blast 3", Shrapnel, Heavy. Drops its charge on targets hiding behind a trench wall.
ATTACK_HALBERD_GUN_DESC: Melee · 2 Hands · Assault, Block, Cumbersome. An invention of the House of Wisdom: both a badge of rank and an excellent weapon.
ATTACK_HALBERD_GUN_SHOT_DESC: 24" · 2 Hands · Assault. The firing profile of the barrel concealed in the Halberd-Gun's haft.
ATTACK_HEAD_TAKER_DESC: Ambush Weapon: +2 Injury Modifier against a target that has not yet Activated.
ATTACK_HEAVY_FLAMETHROWER_DESC: Ignores armour and sets the trench alight. Heavy, fires twice.
ATTACK_HEAVY_SHOTGUN_DESC: 12" · 2 Hands · +1 Dice, +1 Injury Dice, Shotgun, Heavy, Shield Combo. Vast bore; its recoil can only be tamed from a braced stance.
ATTACK_HELLBLADE_DESC: A blade forged in Hell that burns whatever it cuts.
ATTACK_INCENDIARY_GRENADES_DESC: 8" · Ignore Cover, Ignore Long Range, Assault, Fire. Liquid Fire: on a Critical Success the Injury Roll gains [Ignore Armour].
ATTACK_INFERNAL_BOMB_DESC: Artillery Witch's infernal fire bombs from Hell. Ranged, Blast 3", Fire, Deadly, Ignore Cover, Cumbersome.
ATTACK_INFESTED_RIFLE_DESC: Worm-ridden bullets that find the smallest chink in any armour.
ATTACK_IRON_CLAWED_HANDS_DESC: Goetic Warlock's iron-clawed hands. Cleave (2), Critical.
ATTACK_JEZZAIL_DESC: Long-barrelled musket firing alchemical rounds. Assault.
ATTACK_LEGIONARY_GASBOMB_DESC: Poison gas bomb. Assault, Blast 3", Gas, Ignore Armour, Ignore Cover, Ignore Long Range, -1 Injury Dice.
ATTACK_MACHINE_GUN_DESC: A heavy, fully-automatic firearm — Automatic 3, Heavy, Reload.
ATTACK_MALEBRANCHE_SWORD_DESC: A greatsword of the demon-knights. Deadly and heavy.
ATTACK_MAMLUK_GREATSWORD_DESC: Mamluk Faris's great sword of knightly prowess. Cleave (2), +1 Injury Dice.
ATTACK_MARTYRDOM_DEVICE_DESC: Every model within 3" makes an Injury Roll (the trigger rolls 4D6; models within 1" take +1 Injury Dice).
ATTACK_MEDIC_PISTOL_DESC: Combat Medic's pistol. Pistol (dual-use: can also be used as a Melee Weapon — see the second attack option).
ATTACK_MEDIC_PISTOL_MELEE_DESC: Combat Medic's pistol, used as a Melee Weapon (Pistol keyword: can be used as both in the same Activation).
ATTACK_MINE_DETONATION_DESC: A buried charge goes off underfoot, throwing shrapnel.
ATTACK_MISERICORDIA_DESC: Combat Medic's dagger. Ignore Armour against Down targets (Despatch).
ATTACK_MOLOTOV_COCKTAIL_DESC: A bottle of burning fuel. A Critical Success ignores armour.
ATTACK_MURAD_BOMBARD_DESC: Siege mortar. Deadly on the target, everything else in the blast goes Down.
ATTACK_MUSKET_DESC: An antique smoothbore. Slow, weak, but it still kills.
ATTACK_OPHIDIAN_RIFLE_DESC: Unnatural Inversion: Cover and Long Range give +1 Dice instead of -1.
ATTACK_PARASITE_GRENADES_DESC: Terrifying Hallucinations: the target is driven 3" in a straight line.
ATTACK_PISTOL_DESC: Sidearm. Usable in melee and while engaged.
ATTACK_PISTOL_MELEE_DESC: A pistol fired point-blank in the press of melee.
ATTACK_PLAGUE_BLADE_DESC: Rusted and rotting. Every wound festers into Infection.
ATTACK_PLAGUE_SWORD_DESC: Plague-ridden poisoned blade. Poison. Places an Infection Marker on each Scratch.
ATTACK_POISON_STINGERS_DESC: Pit Locust's deadly stinger that inflicts Cleave 2, Shrapnel, and Poisoned wounds.
ATTACK_POLEARM_DESC: A long polearm weapon with Block and Cumbersome traits.
ATTACK_PROPHET_HOLY_MACE_DESC: War Prophet's holy mace. Cleave (1), +1 Injury Dice.
ATTACK_PROPHET_PISTOL_DESC: Prophet's pistol. Assault, Pistol (dual-use — see the second attack option).

ATTACK_SIEGE_JEZZAIL_DESC: An oversized jezzail built to crack fortifications.

ATTACK_SILENCED_PISTOL_MELEE_DESC: Death Commando's silenced pistol, used as a Melee Weapon (Pistol keyword: can be used as both in the same Activation).

FACTION_COURT_OF_SEVEN_HEADED_SERPENT_RU:
Court of Seven Headed Serpent:

- Nobles of the Court: Your warband must include a Praetor OR a Sorcerer as your leader. If you select one as leader, you may include up to one of the other in your warband.

- Goetic Powers: Elite units can cast powerful Goetic spells by paying costs in Blood Markers removed from non-Black Grail/Demonic models.
FACTION_COURT_OF_SEVEN_HEADED_SERPENT_ST: The Court of the Seven Headed Serpent is one of the ancient infernal senates of Hell. Armed with auxilia sorcerors, desecrated saints, and Gehenna demons, this dark court fights to spread venom, hexes, and infernal sorcery. Corrupting their foes' minds is their favorite art.
FACTION_CULT_OF_THE_BLACK_GRAIL_RULES:
Cult of the Black Grail:

- Infection Markers: Certain weapons cause Infection Markers instead of Blood Markers. They multiply over time if left untreated. Activated units with Infection Markers gain 1 more before performing actions.

- Dread of the Plague: Opponents suffer a -1 Dice penalty to all Morale checks (unless they are Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent or Cult of the Black Grail).

- Order of the Fly: The warband must be led by a Lord of Tumours (0-1 Lord, 0-2 Plague Knights) or a Plague Knight (1-3 Plague Knights).
FACTION_CULT_OF_THE_BLACK_GRAIL_STORY: Typhus, malaria, smallpox and trench fever ravage the trenches of the Great War, yet all pale in comparison to the dreaded Black Grail. Beelzebub, Lord of the Flies, does not scheme – he unleashes his deadliest curse from the seventh layer of Hell. The swarm of hell-flies and locusts rampages checkless, consuming everything. The Black Grail infection seeps into living flesh, twisting it with tumours, boils, and weeping pustules, destroying the body while leaving the mind intact to suffer. The infected rise once more under demonic will, forming warbands to spread their master's plague. Led by the depraved knights of the Order of the Fly, they seek to defile sacred grounds and establish Beelzebub's kingdom of decay on Earth.
FACTION_HERETIC_LEGION_STORY: The Heretic Legions are the primary military forces serving the dark powers of Hell. Composed of mortal humans who have renounced God to sign the infernal covenant with their own blood, they stand alongside nightmarish constructs summoned from the depths of Gehenna. They wage a total war of annihilation to 'liberate' humanity from divine punishment, spreading flame and heresy under the banner of the 66 dark warlords.
FACTION_IRON_SULTANATE_STORY: When the Infidels opened the thrice-cursed Gate to Jahannam, unleashing Gog and Magog upon Those Who Believe, it seemed that all was lost and Shaytan would emerge victorious over Dunya. But the Creator of the Universe came to the aid of the Believers, and as had been written, the great Iron Wall of Dhu al-Qarnayn manifested itself in the lands ruled by the Sultan of Rûm. A call was sent to Those Who Believe righteously, and the migration of all Believers took place across Europa, Asia, and Africa. Millions perished on the road and at sea. Yet once all those who survived the journey had come, the mighty Gates of al-Qarnayn were closed, and the Great Sultanate of the Invincible Iron Wall of the Two Horns that Pierce the Sky was formed. The assaults of the slaves of Jahannam have never ceased since. Within the walls, lost knowledge flourishes. The protection of the Iron Wall has had an extensive influence on the Sultanate's way of war: Azebs skirmish, Lions of Jabir harass flanks, Sappers set mines, while the Janissaries Counter-Charge the enemy led by Yüzbaşı Captains. Beyond the Iron Wall, mobile expeditions hunt down apostates, recover lost relics, and crush any who hinder them.
FACTION_NEW_ANTIOCH_RULES:
New Antioch:

- Fireteams: A New Antioch Warband can include up to 2 Fireteams of two models. Models in a Fireteam can be activated simultaneously, allowing actions to be taken in any order. Fireteams are optional and formed by selecting the second model while the first is activating; the pair is kept for the rest of the battle. If either activation is ended by a rule (e.g. a failed Risky roll), it ends for both.

- Concentrated Attack: If a Fireteam model hits a target hit earlier by the other Fireteam member in the same Activation, spend 3 Blood Markers to convert the second attack's Injury Roll to a Bloodbath Roll, even if the target is not Down.
FACTION_NEW_ANTIOCH_STORY: The Principality of New Antioch is the last Christian bastion in the Holy Land. Established after the opening of the Gates of Hell, it is renowned for its high-tech steel walls, mechanized heavy infantry, and sniper priests. They represent the peak of defense, engineering, and discipline in the trenches.
FACTION_RULE_NOT_AVAILABLE_DESC: This Warband has no additional army-wide Faction Rule active in this build. Its identity is expressed entirely through the abilities and equipment of its individual units.
FACTION_SELECT_DESC: In the mud of these trenches, for which divine cause wilt thou shed thy blood?
FACTION_TRENCH_PILGRIMS_STORY: The Trench Pilgrims are a fanatical procession of the Faithful who believe it is their divine duty to march into No Man's Land and sacrifice themselves to cleanse the world. Composed of the guilt-ridden, the mad, and the self-declared saints, they charge devilish forces with absolute disregard for their own lives. Wearing iron capirote hoods to shield their minds from Gehenna's madness, they fight with rusted steel and unyielding zeal.
FAITHFUL_FOLLOWERS_DESC: When activating a model within 1" of this monk, you can also activate the monk: select it during that activation. Actions can be shared in any order; if one activation ends, the other carries on.

HELL_KNIGHT_DESC: Hell Knight: Clad in deep-Gehenna steel plate armor, making them completely immune to armor-piercing effects.

HERALD_OF_BEELZEBUB_DESC: Heralds of Beelzebub: Fly-hybrid flying scouts spreading miasma with their shotgun weapons.
HERETIC_CHORISTER_DESC: Heretic Chorister: Cursed choristers shouting sanity-draining choir songs to break enemy wills.
HERETIC_LEGIONNAIRE_DESC: If upgraded to a Heretic Legionnaire, choose to gain [+1 Dice] for either ranged or melee attacks.
HERETIC_PRIEST_DESC: Heretic Priest: Preachers of the devilish covenant, leading heretic warbands with dark authority.
HERETIC_TROOPER_DESC: Heretic Trooper: Standard infantry soldiers forming the backbone of the Heretic Legions.
HIDE_DESC: If in contact with a terrain piece at least 1/2" high, perform an Action: take a Risky Success Roll (+1 Dice). Success makes this model untargetable by Ranged Attacks/Charges until moving/attacking/retreating or enemy moves within 1.5".

HOLD_YOUR_FIRE_FAIL_LOS: The Lieutenant has no line of sight to that model.
HOUND_OF_THE_BLACK_GRAIL_DESC: Hound of the Black Grail: Mutated beasts hunting down injured targets with plague-infested fangs.
HUNTER_OF_THE_LEFT_HAND_PATH_DESC: Hunter of the Left-Hand Path: A sneaky assassin sneaking behind lines to deliver poisoned backstabs.
INFECTED_PROBOSCIS_DESC: Can make a Melee Attack with the Infection Markers Keyword even without a Melee Weapon. If it causes Infection Markers, you can remove up to 1 Blood Marker from this model.
INFERNAL_BOMB_SCATTER_INFO: The attack missed and will scatter. Click a direction within the highlighted circle — the blast will land exactly that far away. If it lands on a model's base, that model suffers Infernal Strike's Deadly bonus.
INFERNAL_BRAND_DESC: This model is branded with an ever-burning mark. Negate Fire: immune to all fire damage.
INITIATIVE_PROMPT: Choose whether your warband activates first or lets the enemy move first this round.
IRON_CAPIROTE_DESC: Blessed conical helmet. Negate Shrapnel, Negate Fear.
IRON_CLAWED_HANDS_DESC: Can make a Melee Attack with the Cleave 2 and Critical Keywords even without a Melee Weapon — the Off-Hand Weapon modifier applies to this second attack.
IRON_FISTS_DESC: Flesh is as hard as iron. Can make a Melee Attack with the Cleave 2 Keyword even without a Melee Weapon — the Off-Hand Weapon modifier applies to this second attack.
JABIREAN_ALCHEMIST_DESC: Jabirean Alchemist: Scientists channeling Jabir's teachings to heal allies and dissolve foes with acid flasks.
JANISSARY_DESC: Janissaries: Elite heavy infantry of the Sultanate, highly trained in long-range precision shots.
KEYWORD_ASSAULT_DESC: Ranged Attacks with this weapon do not stop the model from also taking a Charge or Fight Action in the same Activation.
KEYWORD_AUTOMATIC_DESC: When Shooting with this weapon, make X separate Ranged Attacks one after another, each resolved individually and able to target different enemies within 6" of each other.
KEYWORD_BLAST_DESC: This weapon has a blast radius of X". On a Success, every model within the radius (with Line of Sight) is hit, not just the target.
KEYWORD_BLESSING_MARKER_DESC: A supernatural or chemical boost. Spend one for +1 Dice on any Action, or -1 Dice on an Injury Roll against this model.
KEYWORD_BLOCK_DESC: Melee Attacks against this model suffer -1 Dice if the attacker Charged into combat this turn.
KEYWORD_BLOOD_MARKER_DESC: Placed on a model that suffers an injury. Spend one for -1 Dice on any Action it takes, or +1 Dice on an Injury Roll against it.
KEYWORD_CLEAVE_DESC: When Fighting with this weapon, make X separate Melee Attacks one after another against enemies within 1" of the attacker.
KEYWORD_COVER_DESC: This model benefits from the Cover or Defended Obstacle attack modifiers.
KEYWORD_CRITICAL_DESC: A Critical Success with this weapon adds +2 Injury Dice instead of the usual +1.
KEYWORD_CUMBERSOME_DESC: This weapon requires two hands, even for models with Strong. It can still be combined with a Shield Combo shield.
KEYWORD_DEADLY_DESC: Injury Rolls made with this weapon use 3D6 instead of 2D6, keeping the 3 highest (or lowest) dice.
KEYWORD_ELITE_DESC: The most senior and heroic models in a Warband.
KEYWORD_FEAR_DESC: Melee Attacks that target this model suffer -1 Dice. Models with Fear are themselves immune to it.
KEYWORD_FIRE_DESC: After the Injury Roll, this weapon places 1 extra Blood Marker on the target, even on a No Effect result.
KEYWORD_FLAMETHROWER_DESC: A Ranged Attack with this weapon automatically Succeeds — no Success Roll is made, so it can never score a Critical Success.
KEYWORD_FLYING_DESC: This model can move through the air, ignoring ground obstacles, and never suffers Injury Rolls from falling.
KEYWORD_GAS_DESC: After the Injury Roll, this weapon places 1 extra Blood Marker on the target, even on a No Effect result.
KEYWORD_GOLEM_DESC: Out of Action results become Down instead (unless caused by a Bloodbath). This model also has Negate Fear and Negate Gas, but can never have Tough.
KEYWORD_HEAVY_DESC: A model can only carry one Heavy weapon, gains no Charge Bonus, and cannot Move, Charge, Retreat or Dash in the same Activation it Shoots this weapon.
KEYWORD_IGNORE_ARMOUR_DESC: This attack ignores the target's Armour Characteristic and any Armour or Shield Battlekit entirely.
KEYWORD_IGNORE_X_DESC: This attack ignores a specific dice modifier — for example, Ignore Cover removes the usual -1 Dice for a target in Cover.
KEYWORD_INFECTION_MARKER_DESC: A supernatural or chemical malady. Works exactly like a Blood Marker for modifying dice, up to a maximum of 6.
KEYWORD_INFILTRATOR_DESC: When first deployed, this model can be set up anywhere on the battlefield out of every enemy's Line of Sight and at least 8" from the nearest enemy. Infiltrators are deployed after models without this keyword; it can always be deployed normally in its zone instead.
KEYWORD_LEADER_DESC: Your Warband gets +1 Dice on Morale Checks while at least one model with this keyword is on the battlefield and not Down or Out of Action.
KEYWORD_NEGATE_X_DESC: This model is completely unaffected by the specified keyword's Effect.
KEYWORD_PISTOL_DESC: Can be used as either a Ranged or Melee weapon, even both in the same Activation, and can be an Off-Hand weapon.
KEYWORD_REGENERATE_DESC: When Activated, this model may remove up to X Blood Markers from itself before taking any Actions.
KEYWORD_RELOAD_DESC: An attack with this weapon ends the model's Activation immediately once the attack is resolved.
KEYWORD_RISKY_DESC: A Success Roll made under this Effect becomes a Risky Success Roll — the model's Activation or Action ends on a Failure.
KEYWORD_SCATTER_DESC: A Blast weapon with Scatter still lands on a failed Success Roll: the attack deviates (7 minus the roll) inches instead of missing outright.
KEYWORD_SHOTGUN_DESC: At Long Range, this weapon adds -1 Injury Dice instead of the usual -1 Dice Long Range penalty.
KEYWORD_SHRAPNEL_DESC: After the Injury Roll, this weapon places 1 extra Blood Marker on the target, even on a No Effect result.
KEYWORD_SKIRMISHER_DESC: When targeted by a Charge, this model may evade before the Charge lands (if not already within 1" of an enemy), moving D3" away.
KEYWORD_STRONG_DESC: This model has Negate Heavy, and may wield one 2-Handed Melee Weapon as if it were 1-Handed.
KEYWORD_TOUGH_DESC: The first Out of Action result this model suffers is treated as a Down result instead.
LAST_SAVE_DETAILS:
The Somme · Day 847
Brother-Sergeant Marcus Holt · 3rd Crusader Division
LAW_OF_HELL_DESC: If any attack by this model takes an enemy Elite model Out of Action, this model gains its freedom and is immediately removed from the game and the Warband Roster — it no longer counts toward Morale Check totals.
LAYING_ON_HANDS_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Success Roll. Success removes 1 Blood Marker from a friendly model within 6" (or self) (3 Blood Markers on Critical Success).
LEADER_CHOICE_DESC: Cult of the Black Grail — choose whether your warband will be led by a Lord of Tumours or a Plague Knight. This choice sets which leader is required and how many of each you may field.
LEFT_HAND_PATH_FAIL_ENEMY: Left-Hand Path: must arrive more than 1" from enemy models.
LEFT_HAND_PATH_FAIL_SAME_PIECE: Left-Hand Path: choose a different terrain piece.
LEFT_HAND_PATH_FAIL_TARGET: Left-Hand Path: choose a point in contact with another terrain piece.
LEFT_HAND_PATH_FAIL_NO_CONTACT: Left-Hand Path: the Hunter must be in contact with a terrain piece.
LEFT_HAND_PATH_DESC: Cast this spell (Cost 2) when moving into contact with a terrain piece: redeploy in contact with another terrain piece, more than 1" from any enemy model. If cast during a Charge, must redeploy closer to the target instead.
LEVITATE_DESC: Do not take a Risky Success Roll when climbing/jumping, or an Injury Roll when falling.
LIEUTENANT_DESC: Lieutenant: Antioch officer who provides tactical orders, giving active units action bonuses on the battlefield.
LIGHTNING_SPEED_DESC: An Observer's Polearm has the Cleave 2 Keyword.
LIONS_OF_JABIR_DESC: Lions of Jabir: Chemically empowered shock homunculi hurling gas flasks at enemies.
LOADOUT_PICKER_INFO: Choose the model's OWN weapon/armour variant for %s. Additional Battlekit is bought from the Armoury once deployment ends.
LOPING_DASH_DESC: Add [+1 Dice] to the Risky Success Roll for this model when taking a Dash Action.
LORD_OF_TUMOURS_DESC: Lord of Tumours: High-ranking plague nobles channeling Beelzebub's corruption on the battlefield.
LOUDSPEAKERS_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Risky Success Roll (+2 Dice). Success allows moving all friendly models within 8" up to 3", ending as close as possible to the nearest visible enemy (counts as charging if contacting an enemy). Failure ends the Activation immediately.
MACHINE_ARMOUR_DESC: -3 Injury Modifier. Steadfast: a Down result on the Injury Table is treated as a Minor Hit instead. Bulky: cannot be equipped with a Trench Shield, and has a Charge Bonus of D3" instead of D6".
MAD_DASH_DESC: Add [+1 Dice] to the Risky Success Roll for this model when taking a Dash Action.
MAMLUK_FARIS_DESC: Mamluk Faris: Elite heavy cavalry charging through trench lines with blazing lances.
MARKER_BLESSING_INFO: How many Blessing Markers to spend against the Injury Roll on %s? (each -1 Injury Dice)
MARKER_BLESSING_SUCCESS_INFO: How many Blessing Markers to spend on %s's own Success Roll? (each +1 Dice)
MARKER_BLOOD_INFO: How many Blood Markers on %s to spend? (each +1 Injury Dice)
MARKER_BLOOD_SUCCESS_INFO: How many Blood Markers on %s to spend against their Success Roll? (each -1 Dice)
MARKER_INFECTION_INFO: How many Infection Markers on %s to spend? (each +1 Injury Dice)
MARKER_INFECTION_SUCCESS_INFO: How many Infection Markers on %s should be spent? (-1 Dice each)
MARTIAL_PROWESS_DESC: Mamluk's Greatsword does not have the Heavy keyword, and its Jezzail has the Assault keyword.
MARTYR_PENITENT_RESURRECTION_DESC: If killed, can be resurrected as a Martyr Penitent for 45. Martyr Penitent gains -1 Injury Dice.
MASTERY_OF_THE_ELEMENTS_DESC: When first deployed, give Fire, Gas or Shrapnel keyword to all this model's weapons.
MECHANIZED_HEAVY_INFANTRY_DESC: Mechanized Heavy Infantry: Clad in steam-powered steel suits, they represent the unstoppable heavy force of Antioch.
MENDELIST_AMMO_MONK_DESC: Mendelist Ammo Monk: Devoted monks distributing consecrated munitions to pilgrims.
MENU_CONTINUE_DESC: Return to your last saved battle, exactly where you left it.
MENU_LOCAL_DESC: Two commanders, one screen — take turns at the same table.
MENU_ONLINE_DESC: Host a battle or join a fellow commander over the network.
MENU_QUIT_DESC: Leave the trenches. The war will wait for thee.
MINE_FAIL_ALREADY_MINED: There is already a mine here.
MINE_FAIL_NO_MINE: There is no mine here to defuse.
MOVE_FAIL_CLIMB_DOWN: Not enough movement to climb down.
MOVE_FAIL_CLIMB_UP: Not enough movement to climb up (must clear the whole wall).
MOVE_FAIL_GENERIC: That move is invalid — check the target is within movement range and on valid ground.
MUBARIZUN_DESC: Add [+1 Injury Dice] for attacks made by a Yüzbaşı if the target model has the Tough Keyword.
NET_ERR_WRONG_PASSWORD: Connection rejected due to password mismatch.
OBSERVER_DESC: Observer: A mysterious warrior monk capable of manipulating time and speed on the battlefield.
ONWARD_CHRISTIAN_SOLDIERS_DESC: Friendly New Antioch models within 8" gain the Negate Fear keyword.
ORACLE_BEAST_CLOAK_DESC: Cast this spell (Cost 3), once per Turn, after an Injury Roll is made against this model; change its result to No Effect.
ORDER_OF_FLY_KNIGHT_DESC: Your warband must include a Plague Knight and may include up to 3.
ORDER_OF_FLY_LORD_DESC: Your warband must include a Lord of Tumours. Up to 1 Lord of Tumours and up to 2 Plague Knights.
OVERWHELMING_HORDE_DESC: Can make Melee attacks unarmed. Add +1 Dice to Melee success roll for each other friendly model within 3".
PARASITE_HOST_DESC: Whenever a Melee Attack causes Blood or Infection Markers on the target, remove up to 1 Blood or Infection Marker from this model.
PILGRIM_BODYGUARD_DESC: If a friendly Pilgrim within 1" is hit by Ranged/Melee attack, this model can take the hit instead (does not work against Blast).
PILGRIM_BODYGUARD_INFO: The attack hit. Should %s take the blow instead?
PIN_DESC: Enemy models that are Down and on bases 40mm or less cannot stand up if this model is within 1".
PIT_LOCUST_DESC: Pit Locust: Flying demon units that ignore ground obstacles and drop toxic gas grenades into trenches.
PLAGUE_KNIGHT_DESC: Plague Knight: A decayed heretic knight clad in rot-infested armor, wielding a disease-ridden blade that spreads pestilence and rot.
PLAGUE_KNIGHT_LOADOUT_COMPANION_MELEE: Knight Companion of the Fly (+1 Melee Dice)
PLAGUE_KNIGHT_LOADOUT_COMPANION_RANGED: Knight Companion of the Fly (+1 Ranged Dice)
POISON_STINGERS_DESC: A Pit Locust can make a Melee Attack with the [Cleave 2] and [Shrapnel] Keywords even though it does not have a Melee Weapon.
PRAETOR_DESC: Praetors are demonic commanders and magistrates within a small corner of the fiefdom of a mighty archdevil or demon lord. Each commands small cohorts at their liege’s behest, raised from the denizens of the ever-shifting domains of Hell. Yoke Fiends muster at their command and Hell Knights, bound to blind obedience, bend their knees to these field commanders of Hell.
PRIZE_SPECIMENS_DESC: When taking a Demonic or Black Grail enemy Out of Action with a melee attack, place 1 Blessing Marker beside this model.
PUPPET_MASTER_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Risky Success Roll: Success allows moving 1 friend or foe within 12" and in Line of Sight by D6" in a straight line. Failure ends the Activation immediately.
PUPPET_MASTER_PICK_INFO: Click anywhere within the highlighted circle — the model will be moved in a straight line toward that point.
PURGE_DESC: If this Sin Eater has a devoured model, take a Success Roll with +4 Dice. On a Success or Critical Success, the devoured model is released within 1", Down.
QUOTE_TEXT: "In the trenches of the damned, faith is both shield and sword. Advance, soldier of the Divine Covenant."
RAVENOUS_INFECTION_DESC: Risky Action: on a Success, place 1 Infection Marker on an enemy model within 1". The model's Activation ends after using this Ability.
ROSTER_FAIL_NOBLES_OF_THE_COURT: Deploy a Praetor or a Sorcerer as your leader (Nobles of the Court).
ROSTER_FAIL_LEADER: Deploy a model whose card carries the "Leader" badge.
SELECT_FAIL_FORCED: Hold Your Fire! — %s must activate first this turn.
NOTICE_ALREADY_ACTIVATED: %s has finished its activation this turn; it acts again next turn.
NOTICE_TURN_ORDER: It's %s's turn. Players activate one model at a time; when an activation ends, the turn passes to the other side.
ROSTER_FAIL_ORDER_OF_THE_FLY: Deploy the leader you chose (a Lord of Tumours or a Plague Knight).
SACRAMENT_CARTRIDGE_DESC: Ranged Weapons (without Blast/Flamethrower) gain Blast 2" and Shrapnel.
SACRAMENT_PICKER_INFO: Choose a Sacrament to bestow on %s (lasts until the end of its next Activation).
SCENARIO_CLAIM_DESC: Battle for control of 5 objectives scattered across No Man's Land. Score 2 VP per Turn for each objective you control; the player with the most VP after 4 Turns wins (or immediately, if the enemy is wiped out or flees).
SCENARIO_FIELDS_OF_GLORY_DESC: Show your might and bravery. VP comes entirely from Glorious Deeds — heroic feats like taking down Elites or striking from above; most VP after 4 Turns wins.
SCENARIO_GREAT_WAR_DESC: To the death! Neither side takes Morale Checks. Score VP equal to each enemy model's Cost ÷10 (rounded up) when you take it Out of Action; most VP after 5 Turns wins (or immediately if the enemy is wiped out).
SCENARIO_HIGH_GROUND_DESC: Capture the high ground at all costs. Score 2 VP per Turn for each of the 5 objectives you control, plus 1 VP each time you take an enemy Out of Action with a Diving Charge; most VP after 5 Turns wins.
SCENARIO_MARKED_FOR_DEATH_DESC: Each side's most valuable model on the field (highest Cost) is openly marked as the "Bounty Target" (☠). Taking down the enemy's Bounty Target earns +3 VP — their army immediately names its next-priciest surviving model as the new target, and the hunt continues. Keeping your own original Bounty Target alive at the end of each Turn earns +1 VP. No special terrain required, standard Morale rules apply.
SCENARIO_RELIC_HUNT_DESC: Find and secure sacred relics for the glory of your Patron. 4 Reliquary markers are set up on the battlefield; a model within 1" of one can take a Claim Reliquary Action (Success Roll) to claim it. At the end of Turn 1 the first 2 Reliquaries are removed, and at the end of Turn 2 the remaining 2 are removed — whoever holds each one at that moment keeps it permanently. No Morale Checks, no fleeing: fight to the death.
SCENARIO_SELECT_DESC: Select the scenario for this battle. Each scenario has its own objectives and victory conditions.
SCENARIO_WAITING_HOST: Waiting for the host to choose a scenario…
SCRIPTURE_GUARDIAN_DESC: Scripture Guardian: A resurrected entity reciting sacred scriptures to smite foes and protect relics.
SET_MINE_DESC: Action to set a mine on an adjacent unmined terrain piece (roll with +2 Dice). Success makes the terrain Mined.
SHADOW_WALKER_DESC: Cast this spell (Cost 2) before taking a Retreat Action; enemy models cannot make a Melee Attack on the spellcaster when they retreat.
SHOCKTROOPER_DESC: Shocktrooper: Frontline assault troopers specialized in storming trenches with high melee ferocity.
SHOCK_CHARGE_DESC: When rolling the Charge Bonus, roll 1 extra D6 and use the single highest die.
SHRINE_ANCHORITE_DESC: Shrine Anchorite: Colossal diesel-powered walking shrines piloted by a praying monk.
SHRINE_LOADOUT_BROKEN: Broken on the Wheel (Armour 0, no Tough/Negate Shrapnel until first Out of Action)
SIN_EATER_DESC: Sin Eater: Gluttonous demons who feed on blood markers to restore their health.
SIN_ENVY_AURA: Enemy models within 3" cannot benefit from friendly abilities.
SIN_GLUTTONY_AURA: Enemy models within 3" cannot be healed (Treat/Laying on Hands).
SIN_GREED_AURA: Enemy models within 3" gain +1 Blood Marker on failed Retreat.
SIN_PRIDE_AURA: Enemy models within 3" suffer -1 to Willpower tests.
SIN_SELECTION_DESC: Court of the Seven-Headed Serpent — choose a Sin to grant your warband a Demonic Aura. The selected sin affects enemy models near your demons.
SIN_SLOTH_AURA: Enemy models within 3" have halved Movement.
SIN_WRATH_AURA: Enemy models within 3" suffer -1 Dice to Melee Success Rolls.
SISTER_OF_SAINT_COSMAS_DESC: Sister of Saint Cosmas: Devout battlefield healers tending to wounded crusaders with blessed ointments, whilst showing no mercy when dispatching Heretics.
SIX_ARMED_MONSTROSITY_DESC: Can shoot with each equipped Ranged weapon and fight with each Melee weapon per activation. No off-hand melee penalty.
SKIRMISHER_DESC: When charged, if not within 1" of enemies, this model can Evade, moving D3" away.
SLAVEMASTER_CMD_FIGHT: Fight Command (the Yoke Fiend makes a Melee Attack)
SLAVEMASTER_CMD_MOVE: Move Command (the Yoke Fiend makes a Move)
SLAVEMASTER_CMD_SACRIFICE: Sacrifice Command (the Yoke Fiend is taken Out of Action)
SLAVEMASTER_CMD_SHOOT: Shoot Command (the Yoke Fiend makes a Ranged Attack)
SLAVEMASTER_DESC: Perform a Slavemaster Goetic Spell (Cost 1) to issue a Move/Shoot/Fight/Sacrifice command to a Yoke Fiend within 18".
SLAVEMASTER_FAIL_NO_ENGAGED_ENEMY: This Yoke Fiend isn't engaged with an enemy.
SLAVEMASTER_FAIL_NO_MELEE: This Yoke Fiend has no Melee weapon.
SLAVEMASTER_FAIL_NO_RANGED: This Yoke Fiend has no Ranged weapon.
SLAVEMASTER_FAIL_OUT_OF_RANGE: Target is out of the weapon's range.
SLAVEMASTER_FIGHT_PICK_INFO: Click a ringed engaged enemy for the Yoke Fiend to attack.
SOUND_RETREAT_INFO: Your Morale Check failed. Flee now and lose the game instead of becoming Shaken?
SKIRMISHER_EVADE_INFO: %s is charging this model. Evade before the charge? Roll a D3 and move up to that many inches, finishing more than 1" from all enemies.
SKIRMISHER_EVADE_PICK_INFO: Click within the highlighted circle. The model must finish more than 1" away from all enemies.
OFFHAND_PICK_INFO: Click a ringed enemy to strike with the second weapon (-1 Dice), or press Cancel to skip.
PICK_FAIL_NOT_CANDIDATE: Click an enemy model marked with a ring.
CLEAVE_PICK_INFO: Click a ringed enemy for the next Cleave attack.
AUTOMATIC_PICK_INFO: Click a ringed enemy for the next shot (within 6" of the first target).
SLAVEMASTER_MOVE_PICK_INFO: Click anywhere within the highlighted circle to move the Yoke Fiend there.
SLAVEMASTER_PICKER_INFO: Choose the Command to issue to %s.
SLAVEMASTER_SHOOT_PICK_INFO: Click a ringed enemy for the Yoke Fiend to fire at.
SLOW_DESC: Treat this model as having a Movement of 3"/Infantry when taking a Dash Action.
SNIPER_PRIEST_DESC: Sniper Priest: Precision marksmen chanting prayers while eliminating key targets from long ranges.
SORCERER_DESC: Sorcerer: mysterious heretical caster utilizing Goetic magic and spells to manipulate the flow of battle.
SORCERER_GOETIC_NONE: Blessings of the Serpent Moon only (free)
SPECIAL_AMMUNITION_INFO: Choose the effect for this Injury Roll against %s.
STATUS_DEFAULT: Host a battle, or join one by its address.
STEALTH_GENERATOR_DESC: Add [-1 Dice] to rolls for Ranged Attacks targeting this model.
STIGMATIC_NUN_DESC: Stigmatic Nun: Swordmasters drawing divine speed and strength from their bleeding stigmata wounds.
SULTANATE_ASSASSIN_DESC: Sultanate Assassin: Cloaked killers bypassing guards to execute heretic leaders.
SULTANATE_SAPPER_DESC: Sultanate Sapper: Engineers maintaining trenches and demolishing enemy walls.
SWORN_BRETHREN_DESC: Can form a Fireteam with 1 Elite model (in addition to other Fireteams). Select the Elite model while the Mamluk is activating to pair them for the rest of the battle.
SYMPHONY_OF_SLAUGHTER_DESC: Armed with Catherine Wheel and Bonebreaker Mace. Can attack once with either, or twice (using off-hand rules).
TEETH_AND_CLAWS_DESC: Hound's teeth and claws melee attack.
TEMPORAL_ASSASSIN_DESC: On charge, choose an additional target and resolve two fight actions, teleporting between targets.
TEMPORAL_ASSASSIN_PICK2_INFO: Click a ringed enemy to charge through time and strike it too, or press Cancel to end here.
TEMPORAL_FUGE_DESC: Add -1 Dice to rolls for Ranged Attacks and Melee Attacks that target this model.
TERRAIN_MINE_DESC: A buried charge. It detonates when a model moves into contact with it, unless that model set the mine or has the Defuse Mine ability.
TERRAIN_TRENCH_DESC: A dug-in position. Models on or within it have the [Cover] Keyword: ranged attacks against them suffer -1 Dice.
THE_AMMUNITION_SACRAMENT_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Risky Success Roll. Success lets you pick a friendly model within 1" and grant it one of three Sacraments until the end of its next Activation. Failure ends the Activation immediately.
TIME_SLIP_DESC: If an opponent fails a success roll targeting this model, you can redeploy it anywhere within 6", more than 1" away from enemies.
TIME_SLIP_INFO: The attack against %s missed. Slip into a moment in the future (redeploy within 6")?
TIME_SLIP_PICK_INFO: Click anywhere within the highlighted circle to redeploy there.
TORTURER_DESC: When making a Melee Attack, can target a friendly non-Demonic model instead of an enemy — but cannot attack again this Activation.
TRAMPLE_DESC: Can make a Melee Attack against a Down enemy. This attack does not use a Melee Weapon and has Ignore Armour.
TREAT_CHOICE_INFO: Choose the effect to apply to %s.
TREAT_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Risky Success Roll. Success allows standing up a Down friendly model within 1" or removing 1 Blood Marker within 1". Failure ends the Activation immediately.
TREAT_FAIL_GLUTTONY: That model is inside a Gluttony Aura and cannot be healed.
TRENCH_CLERIC_DESC: Trench Cleric: Holy priest bolstering ally faith and helping units resist psychological dread.
TRENCH_MOLE_DESC: This scout gains the Infiltrator keyword, allowing it to deploy out of LoS and 8" away from enemy models.
TRENCH_PILGRIM_DESC: Trench Pilgrim: Core infantry zealots charging heretics with holy maces under iron capirotes.
TRIGGER_MARTYRDOM_DEVICE_DESC: Action (no roll): triggers the Martyrdom Device (Consumable, one use only). All models within 3" (friend or foe, including this one) take an Injury Roll. This model's own Injury Roll uses 4D6 added together; other models within 1" get +1 Injury Dice.
UNHOLY_HYMNS_DESC: Add [-1 Dice] to Success Rolls taken for enemy models within 8".
UNSTOPPABLE_DESC: Adjacent enemy models on a 32mm-or-smaller base cannot make a Melee Attack when this model retreats. Can take a Move or Charge Action even while engaged, as long as every enemy within 1" is on a 32mm-or-smaller base.
VENGEFUL_SCRIPTURE_DESC: Perform an Action: pick 1 enemy within 18" and in Line of Sight, then take a Success Roll (+2 Dice if the enemy is within 9", +1 Dice otherwise). On a Success, make an Injury Roll against that enemy with +1 Injury Modifier per Blood Marker it has. On a Critical Success, also gain Ignore Armour and +1 Injury Dice.
VICTORY_DESC: The crusade succeeded. Cursed ones purged.
VOICE_OF_GOD_DESC: Perform an Action, take a Risky Success Roll. On a Success, pick any not-yet-activated model (friend or foe) anywhere on the battlefield: this model's Activation ends and that model's Activation begins immediately instead. On a Failure, this model's Activation simply ends.
WAITING_OTHER_SQUAD: All soldiers deployed. Waiting for other squad...
WAITING_RECONNECT: Waiting for your opponent to reconnect…
WAITING_RECONNECT_SUB: The campaign is temporarily suspended. Waiting for the other player to join.
WAR_PROPHET_DESC: War Prophet: Spiritual leaders guiding Pilgrim warbands through divine battle visions.
WAR_WOLF_ASSAULT_BEAST_DESC: War Wolf Assault Beast: Mutated predators bound with spikes and barbed wire, tearing infantry apart.
WHIP_OF_GOD_DESC: A Castigator can Melee Attack a friendly model within 1". Each friendly model taken Out of Action this way adds [+1 Dice] to the warband's next Morale Check.
WITCHBURNER_DESC: Witchburner: Cleansing zealots burning witches and demons with holy flamethrowers.
WRETCHED_DESC: Wretched: Shattered souls left behind by demonic torture, swarming enemies in desperation.
YEOMAN_DESC: Yeoman: Loyal local militia of Antioch who stand firm and ignore panic checks even when wounded.
YOKE_FIEND_DESC: Yoke Fiend: A colossal tortured demon who channels pain from heavy chains into permanent melee rage.
YUZBASI_DESC: Yuzbasi: Experienced commanders leading Sultanate units beyond the Iron Wall.
MOVE_FAIL_RETREAT_BLOCKED: No clear retreat position — cannot end more than 1" from all enemies.
